summary: Something finally watches: Prometheus scrapes the metrics, Alertmanager routes, and an alert reaches the Discord review channel — plus Sentry for the errors that do throw.
details: Until now nothing read any of it. 94 nora_* series were exposed on :9100 with no scraper of any kind — no established connection to the port — while nora-egress.service sat in `failed` for sixteen days and nothing said so. deploy/prometheus/ scrapes nora, presence and analytics; six rules alert on absences (a target gone, a stalled heartbeat, a silent platform, any counter reporting R-27's `unavailable`, media custody switched off while attachments arrive, and Prometheus losing sight of itself); deploy/alert-bridge/ turns an Alertmanager webhook into a Signal message. The bridge is a separate stdlib-only container and deliberately does not route through Nora, because the most important alert it can send is that Nora is down. Sentry is wired alongside for error capture only — traces_sample_rate is 0, since a second tracing pipeline would write a second incompatible trace id for the same turn — and is off by default, needing both `[obs.errors] enabled` and a DSN in the named environment variable.
